_meta.note: Curated Provincial/Territorial Nominee Program skilled-worker streams. Quebec excluded (separate selection system). Business/entrepreneur/investor streams excluded (not NOC/duties-driven). Every stream's category, status, and any stated fee/CLB/TEER is verified against the official provincial/territorial source listed in sourceUrl, on lastVerified. Fields the source did not state are null. EE-linked streams carry an 'active IRCC Express Entry profile' condition so the engine never reports 'confirmed' on a multi-step PNP outcome. Sources are the IRCC-listed official PNP sites only.
